key_schedule.absolute_step_key: For zero-based absolute step k: jax.random.fold_in(jax.random.PRNGKey(seed), k + 1)
key_schedule.paired_suffix_indexing: Both branches reset with the same seed and replay the same literal prefix. A suffix of prefix length L begins at absolute k = L, never at k = 0.
key_schedule.terminal_handling: The later executor should record terminal results and stop the script; any separately tested terminal call uses the absorbing raw contract. No reset occurs mid-script.

randomness_use: Deterministic reset and transition. The supplied reset and raw-step keys are intentionally unused; there is no stochastic distribution or hidden PRNG state.

scripts.intended_objective: Attempt cargo launch, an open-gate water pulse, then bridge crossing and lower-bank irrigation. This is not a promised delivery trajectory.
scripts.scope: Source-level short interaction witness; not an executed trajectory or success certificate
scripts.intended_events: Read only the native scene/event channels during a later independently authorized replay; preserve any failure.

paired_intervention_hypotheses.intended_difference: Opening versus closing the upstream edge is hypothesized to alter transit, downstream depth and later partner cargo opportunities under the same other-role actions.
paired_intervention_hypotheses.comparison_scope: Same reset seed, same literal prefix, and identical non-intervened-role suffix actions; descriptive causal hypothesis only.
